description: This file contains the implementation of the Response interface, specifically the ResponseImpl class, which manages a mapping of LoggerData objects to Double values, along with a timestamp. It provides methods to set data values, retrieve all data keys, and get individual data values, along with a constructor that initializes the timestamp.

classes.name: ResponseImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Response interface, managing data values associated with LoggerData objects and a timestamp.

methods.name: ResponseImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the timestamp to the current system time.

methods.name: setDataValue
methods.description: Stores a data value associated with a specific LoggerData key.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the set of LoggerData keys currently stored.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific LoggerData key, returning 0.0 if not found.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the object was instantiated.
